lifetime.cancel: Held stdin closes on abort/deadline/parent exit. Helper EOF reader exits its own process even while query or stdout write blocks.
lifetime.selfExit: Unix _exit / Windows TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess) avoid atexit pipe-flush locks
lifetime.uncertainCleanup: Caller settles after 1000ms grace with cleanupPending; unref/destroy pipes without claiming child exit, and retain each of two ownership slots until close.
